_comment: Insight nodes about the Vagrant's own form -- what he has come to understand about himself through play. Category=self. Each unlock progressively reveals one ledger row on the Vessel-tab Overview sub-page (per the locked progressive-disclosure design: the Vagrant only sees ledgers for things he has the conceptual frame for).

knows_substance_taken._comment: Fires on first sangue absorption (lifetime ledger crosses 1). Implied lesson: killing a thing yields a count. Unlocks the vessel-held ledger row on the Vessel Overview.

knows_substance_committed._comment: Fires on signing_committed flag (Beat 4 Signing). The Signing IS the first commit act -- the moment substance leaves the Vagrant by being committed (Crucible installation or Censer release). Unlocks the riversato ledger row.

knows_substance_lifetime._comment: Fires on signing_committed flag (same as knows_substance_committed). Doctrine: the moment the Vagrant understands substance can be committed, he implicitly understands he's been accumulating it across his existence. Unlocks the lifetime-accumulated ledger row. Future: split if a specific reveal surface for lifetime accounting is authored separately.
